header.config: strength rule: skor dukungan − skor pengerasan; stem=2, branch=1; strong ≥ +2, weak ≤ −2, balanced otherwise. +1 if element sama dengan / menghasilkan day master; −1 jika day master menghasilkannya / elemen mengontrol day master / day master mengontrolnya.
header.note: Four synthetic FourPillars charts, hand-scored. 2 must classify strong, 2 weak. No BirthData — passed directly to computeStrength.

cases.description: Wood day master (甲), all four pillars 甲寅 — every stem wood (+2) and branch wood (+1) supports. Score = 4 * (2+1) = +12 → strong.

Fire day master (丙). Year 甲寅: wood generates fire (+3). Month 丙午: fire same (+3). Day 丙午: fire same (+3). Hour 甲子: wood stem generates fire (+2) but water branch controls fire (−1) → +1. Total +10 → strong.

Metal day master (庚). Metal generates water (drain, −1). Year/Month/Hour 壬子: water stem −2 + water branch −1 = −3 each. Day 庚子: metal stem same +2, water branch drain −1 → +1. Total −3 −3 +1 −3 = −8 → weak.

Earth day master (戊). Wood controls earth (−1); earth controls water (−1 wealth); earth generates metal (−1 output). Year 甲寅: wood controls earth −3. Month 壬子: earth controls water (wealth) −3. Day 戊申: earth same +2, metal drain −1 → +1. Hour 甲寅: wood controls earth −3. Total −3 −3 +1 −3 = −8 → weak.
